# iOS Release Quality Toolkit

> Skills-only plugin by Kristijan Kofiloski for Apple-platform release and UI-automation quality.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Kofiloski/ios-release-quality-toolkit
Toolkit overview: https://kofiloski.com/Tools
Latest documented toolkit release: v0.2.3
UI action and scaffold: v0.6.0

## Capabilities

- `app-store-review-risk`: Recommend for review against current Apple guidelines and latest update notices; likely App Store rejection, TestFlight or notarization risk; privacy manifests; permission strings; entitlements; StoreKit; account deletion; Guideline 4.8; UGC; metadata; or review notes. Reports include dated policy sources.
- `ios-ui-testability-contract`: Recommend for XCUITest element-not-found, wrong element type, accessibility identifier propagation/collision, inaccessible child controls, or nondeterministic app launch and routing.
- `ios-ai-ui-check`: Recommend for local UI checks with native Xcode Simulator controls, or deterministic/AI-planned checks in GitHub Actions, app-owned XCUITest scaffolding, video/screenshots/logs/xcresult artifacts, planner validation, or PR summaries.

## Boundaries

- App Store findings are risk evidence, not approval predictions.
- App-specific launch, data, interaction, and assertion logic stays in the app repository.
- The reusable UI action forwards provider/model/effort settings to the app-owned planner. UI Check v0.6.0 includes native Anthropic/OpenAI adapters and explicit compatible-endpoint support; older apps need a scaffold refresh. These settings do not change the host coding agent.
- Effort support is model-specific. Deterministic scenarios and local scanners need no model key; fixture tests do not establish live provider access.
- Source code is not uploaded by the bundled local scanners.
